title: Modeling ledger: every business function of a full company simulation, and how far this engine is from it
rules: Structure and maturity only. No game values, no market data, no fitted coefficients.

real_status: measured = seen in the captured Q1 menu or reproduced by an experiment; inferred = a client screen is registered but was not seen in Q1, and/or a public teaching source describes it (unverified until captured); unknown = no evidence either way.
Anything inferred stays 'unverified, awaiting capture' until a later quarter is captured.
Downstream numbers always take the weakest maturity of their inputs.

maturity_legend.verified: Captured from the game and reproduced (or fitted on game data and passed hold-out validation).
maturity_legend.literature: Functional form backed by published literature; coefficients not calibrated on this game.
maturity_legend.heuristic: Practice rule from general business sense; no literature, no calibration. Lowest rung. Placeholder accounting rules (structure from game parameters, combination unverified) are heuristic too.
maturity_legend.not-modeled: The real game has it; this engine does not.

kind_legend.behaviour: A causal response (a lever moves demand, retention ...). Heuristic behaviour is the riskiest: it can be mistaken for real cause and effect.
kind_legend.accounting: A bookkeeping rule. Upgrades straight to verified by a controlled experiment; literature does not apply.
kind_legend.information: Buys or shows information; changes no number of the quarter.
kind_legend.qualitative: Text or planning decisions; no known numeric effect.
kind_legend.scenario: An assumption the player chooses (rival behaviour). Results are conditional on it.

sources.E-Q1: Captured Q1 menu (docs/module-map.md section 1): screen names only.
sources.E-REG: Client screen registry (docs/module-map.md section 2; field names in docs/decision-catalog.md): the screen exists in the delivered client; whether a course shows it, and when, is unverified.
sources.E-EXP: Controlled experiments EXP-01, EXP-02, EXP-11, EXP-12 (docs/experiments/).

Syllabus 'Managerial Game (Business Management)', University of Rzeszow, using Cadotte, The Business Management Simulation (2005) and Cadotte & Bruce, The Management of Strategy in the Marketplace (2008). https://www.ur.edu.pl/files/ur/import/Import/2012/7/MANAGERIAL-GAME-(BUSINESS-MANAGEMENT).pdf

sources.R-GOOSEN1999: Goosen, K.R., Jensen, R. & Wells, R.A. (1999). Purpose and learning benefits of business simulations: a design and development perspective. Developments in Business Simulation and Experiential Learning 26 (reports Keys & Biggs 1990: price, R&D and production scheduling common to all ten games compared).

sources.R-CAPSIM: Capsim, Capstone team member guide, 'Company Departments' (public guide): R&D, marketing, production, finance; optional HR and TQM modules feeding a balanced scorecard.
sources.R-MARKSTRAT: StratX, Markstrat public description: brand portfolio, R&D projects, production, price, advertising, sales force size and channel allocation, market research.
sources.L-SETHURAMAN2011: Sethuraman, R., Tellis, G.J. & Briesch, R. (2011). How well does advertising work? Generalizations from meta-analysis of brand advertising elasticities. Journal of Marketing Research 48(3), 457-471 (mean short-term 0.12, long-term 0.24).
sources.L-LITTLE1970: Little, J.D.C. (1970). Models and managers: the concept of a decision calculus. Management Science 16(8), B466-B485 (ADBUDG).
sources.L-CLARKE1976: Clarke, D.G. (1976). Econometric measurement of the duration of advertising effect on sales. Journal of Marketing Research 13, 345-357.
sources.L-KOHLER2017: Kohler, C., Mantrala, M.K., Albers, S. & Kanuri, V.K. (2017). A meta-analysis of marketing communication carryover effects. Journal of Marketing Research 54(6), 990-1008.
sources.L-NAIK2003: Naik, P.A. & Raman, K. (2003). Understanding the impact of synergy in multimedia communications. Journal of Marketing Research 40(4), 375-388.
sources.L-VAKRATSAS2004: Vakratsas, D., Feinberg, F.M., Bass, F.M. & Kalyanaram, G. (2004). The shape of advertising response functions revisited. Marketing Science 23(1), 109-119.
sources.L-ALBERS2010: Albers, S., Mantrala, M.K. & Sridhar, S. (2010). Personal selling elasticities: a meta-analysis. Journal of Marketing Research 47(5), 840-853 (506 estimates; mean 0.34, about 0.31 after method-bias correction; abstract verified).
sources.L-LODISH1971: Lodish, L.M. (1971). CALLPLAN: an interactive salesman's call planning system. Management Science 18(4-II), P25-P40.
sources.L-ZOLTNERS2004: Zoltners, A.A., Sinha, P. & Lorimer, S.E. (2004). Sales Force Design for Strategic Advantage. Palgrave Macmillan.
sources.L-ARTHUR2003: Arthur, W. Jr., Bennett, W., Edens, P.S. & Bell, S.T. (2003). Effectiveness of training in organizations: a meta-analysis. Journal of Applied Psychology 88(2), 234-245 (general training, not sales-specific).
sources.L-COUGHLAN1992: Coughlan, A.T. & Narasimhan, C. (1992). An empirical analysis of sales-force compensation plans. Journal of Business 65(1), 93-121.
sources.L-LUCAS1987: Lucas, G.H., Parasuraman, A., Davis, R.A. & Enis, B.M. (1987). An empirical study of salesforce turnover. Journal of Marketing 51(3), 34-59.
sources.L-GRIFFETH2000: Griffeth, R.W., Hom, P.W. & Gaertner, S. (2000). A meta-analysis of antecedents and correlates of employee turnover. Journal of Management 26(3), 463-488 (pay vs turnover rho about -0.09; -0.12 in 1990s studies; no elasticity).
sources.L-DEMAND: docs/demand-literature.md (sources of the literature demand chain: multinomial logit / MCI attraction, outside option, distribution elasticity).
sources.E-STMT: Captured Q1 pro-forma statements (cash flow, income statement, balance sheet): row structure, signs and calculated flags only; the totals are server-computed. Private.
sources.L-COOPER1988: Cooper, L.G. & Nakanishi, M. (1988). Market-Share Analysis: Evaluating Competitive Marketing Effectiveness. Kluwer (MCI: one multiplicative term with its own elasticity per marketing instrument).
sources.L-DOLAN1987: Dolan, R.J. (1987). Quantity discounts: managerial issues and research opportunities. Marketing Science 6(1), 1-22 (all-units and incremental discount schedules).
sources.L-MONAHAN1984: Monahan, J.P. (1984). A quantity discount pricing model to increase vendor profits. Management Science 30(6), 720-726.
sources.L-HARRIS1913: Harris, F.W. (1913). How many parts to make at once. Factory, The Magazine of Management 10(2), 135-136 (holding cost proportional to inventory value).
sources.L-AZZI2014: Azzi, A., Battini, D., Faccio, M., Persona, A. & Sgarbossa, F. (2014). Inventory holding costs measurement: a multi-case study. International Journal of Logistics Management 25(1), 109-132 (review quotes 12-34% and 20-50% of inventory value per year).
sources.L-FARRELL2001: Farrell, S. & Hakstian, A.R. (2001). Improving salesforce performance: a meta-analytic investigation of the effectiveness and utility of personnel selection procedures and training interventions. Psychology & Marketing 18(3), 281-316 (not yet verified in full text).

modules.name: 需求核心（區隔選擇與外部選項）
modules.real_note: Sales and market share are reported every quarter; the game's demand formula itself is not observable.
modules.ours: LiteratureDemand: multinomial-logit / MCI attraction with an outside option (src/marketplace_sim/demand.py).
modules.next_step: To verified: fit the coefficients on Q2+ demand panels (FittedDemand) and pass hold-out validation (MAPE <= 20 %, direction hit rate >= 70 %).

modules.name: 目標區隔選擇
modules.real_note: Target Segments is a decision screen in the captured Q1 menu.
modules.ours: Each brand targets a segment; fit to other segments falls with need similarity (demand chain).
modules.next_step: To verified: calibrate similarity_power and fit_weight on Q2+ brand-by-segment sales.

modules.name: 品牌設計（類型與元件）
modules.real_note: Design Brand is a decision screen in the captured Q1 menu.
modules.ours: Brand type and components chosen per brand; fit enters the demand chain; component choice also drives the (heuristic) unit cost.
modules.next_step: To verified: relate brand-judgment scores to sales once Q2 reports are captured; fit the quality term.

modules.name: 產品線（多品牌與相互侵蝕）
modules.real_note: Several brands can be designed on the Q1 brand screen.
modules.ours: Several brands per firm; they compete for the same buyers inside the logit (cannibalisation).
modules.next_step: To verified: check cannibalisation against Q2+ brand-level sales.

modules.name: 定價
modules.real_note: A Pricing screen is registered but was not in the Q1 menu; public teaching sources list pricing.
modules.ours: Price relative to willingness to pay enters the utility (price_sensitivity).
modules.next_step: To verified: fit price_sensitivity on Q2+ price and sales variation.

modules.name: 促銷（回饋金、贈品、店頭陳列）
modules.real_note: Rebate and point-of-purchase fields on Pricing; a Promotions screen is registered.
modules.ours: None.
modules.next_step: To heuristic: rebate lowers the effective price for the share of buyers who redeem it, and costs rebate x redeemed units; free gift as a fixed cost per unit with a small attraction lift.

modules.name: 廣告預算與累積效果
modules.real_note: Media and ad screens are registered; public teaching sources describe advertising decisions.
modules.ours: Goodwill stock with carryover; power or ADBUDG response with diminishing returns (demand chain).
modules.next_step: To verified: fit ad_elasticity and carryover on Q2+ data; keep the literature ranges as priors.

modules.name: 廣告媒體分配
modules.real_note: Local, regional, social and search media screens are registered; public sources describe media selection.
modules.ours: MediaMixLiterature: per-medium MCI advertising terms; the demand chain's own elasticity is split across media by weights w_m (sum 1). The best split is s_m = w_m, which reproduces the single literature response; any other split loses part of it.
modules.next_step: To verified: estimate the media weights w_m (and test a cross-media synergy term, Naik & Raman 2003) on Q2+ media-level spend and sales; pass hold-out validation. Still uncalibrated: the weights (neutral equal default; no published general ranking of these media).

modules.name: 廣告訊息與文案
modules.real_note: Ad design screen and ad judgment report are registered; public sources mention ad copy and appeals.
modules.ours: None (advertising has no message content).
modules.next_step: To heuristic: message fit = similarity of the stressed benefits to the target segment's needs, multiplying ad effectiveness.

modules.name: 網路行銷（網頁、流量、社群）
modules.real_note: Web page, traffic and productivity screens are registered.
modules.ours: None beyond the web center's distribution weight.
modules.next_step: To heuristic: web traffic budget raises web-channel coverage with diminishing returns; page quality multiplies conversion.

modules.name: 市場調查購買
modules.real_note: Market research purchase screens are registered; public sources list a research budget.
modules.ours: None (all research data the pack holds is visible).
modules.next_step: To heuristic: a cost line plus gating which reports are shown; no effect on demand.

modules.name: 開店（設立成本）
modules.real_note: Open Stores is a decision screen in Q1; opening cost reproduced by EXP-11.
modules.ours: Opening cost = setup cost of newly opened stores (cost_model).
modules.next_step: Keep: re-run EXP-11 if the screen changes in a later quarter.

modules.name: 網路銷售中心（設立成本）
modules.real_note: Open Web Sales Center is a decision screen in Q1; opening cost reproduced by EXP-12. Not found in public descriptions.
modules.ours: Opening cost = setup cost of newly opened web centers.
modules.next_step: Keep: re-run EXP-12 if the screen changes.

modules.name: 通路覆蓋對需求的效果
modules.real_note: A channel demand report is registered; the effect of an open outlet on demand is not observable in Q1.
modules.ours: Coverage = 1 - (1 - store)(1 - web weight x web), raised to the distribution elasticity.
modules.next_step: To verified: fit distribution_elasticity and web_weight on Q2+ city-level sales.

modules.name: 通路租金
modules.real_note: Lease cost is a field on the Q1 outlet screens; when it is charged was not observed (EXP-11/12 showed none in the opening quarter).
modules.ours: Placeholder: lease of outlets open at quarter start. Verified branch: nothing open at quarter start means no lease (EXP-11/12 measured no lease in the opening quarter).
modules.next_step: Cannot be verified by arithmetic alone: needs the game's charge in the quarter after an opening. Read the Q2 statement after a Q1 opening; reproduce the lease row with zero residual.

modules.name: 業務編制與招募
modules.real_note: Hire Sales People is registered but not in the Q1 menu; public sources list the number of salespeople employed.
modules.ours: SalesForceModule: selling effort = (1 + force per market / reference)^elasticity, the elasticity inside the meta-analytic range; multiplies the attraction of our offers. Hiring cost lines stay heuristic.
modules.next_step: To verified: fit the elasticity and the reference scale on Q2+ sales by quarter and headcount; the game's hiring cost rule needs the HireSalesPeople calculate (awaiting Q2 capture).

modules.name: 業務薪酬、佣金與留任
modules.real_note: Industry Sales Force Compensation is a report in the Q1 menu (measured); the decision screen (SalesForceCompensation) is registered but not seen.
modules.ours: SalesForceModule (heuristic part): quit rate falls with relative pay (salary and commission), bounded; salaries and commission are expenses (cost rule unobserved).
modules.next_step: Stays heuristic until game data: the literature gives only small negative correlations between pay and turnover (Griffeth et al. 2000, rho about -0.09), no elasticity. To verified: observe headcount changes against pay from Q2 on.

modules.name: 業務訓練
modules.real_note: Special Programs (training, demo kit, contest) is registered; public sources list training.
modules.ours: SalesForceModule (heuristic part): training builds a decaying skill stock that raises effective force; any skill makes the demand chain heuristic.
modules.next_step: To literature: verify Farrell & Hakstian 2001 in full text (a 23.1% productivity gain from training across 12 effect sizes, seen only as an abstract snippet) and bound the training lift by it; until then heuristic. To verified: observe the SpecialPrograms effect from Q2 on.

modules.name: 網路業務人員
modules.real_note: Hire Web Sales People is registered; demand projection screens have per-web-salesperson fields.
modules.ours: None (the sales force is company-wide).
modules.next_step: To heuristic: split selling effort into store and web forces; web effort applies to web coverage only.

modules.name: 生產工人薪酬與生產力
modules.real_note: Industry Production Worker Compensation is a Q1 report; worker compensation and productivity screens are registered.
modules.ours: None (labour is a fixed per-unit amount inside the unit cost).
modules.next_step: To heuristic: worker pay against a reference sets productivity and turnover; productivity scales usable capacity.

modules.name: 主管薪酬、員工參與與人資調查
modules.real_note: Executive compensation, employee involvement and HR survey screens are registered.
modules.ours: None.

modules.name: 固定產能投資
modules.real_note: Fixed Capacity is a Q1 decision screen; capacity cost reproduced by EXP-02.
modules.ours: Capacity option cost; capacity per quarter = units/day x days per quarter; usable next quarter.
modules.next_step: Keep.

modules.name: 單位生產成本
modules.real_note: The captured Q1 brand screen lists component prices and cost adjustment, but also learning-curve, scale-threshold, variable labour and overhead, and inefficiency parameters; the combination is unobserved.
modules.ours: Placeholder: sum(component price) x cost adjustment + minimum labour + minimum overhead (ignores learning curve, scale and variable terms). Verified branch: nothing produced costs nothing. Material part can be scaled by the purchasing module.
modules.next_step: Cannot be verified by arithmetic alone: needs the game's cost of production for a known brand and volume (Q2 cost-of-production report or the FactorySimulation calculate).

modules.name: 設計與開線費
modules.real_note: Design and setup cost are Q1 brand-screen parameters; when they are charged is unverified.
modules.ours: Placeholder: design cost per new brand. Verified branch: no new brand designed means no design cost (structural zero).
modules.next_step: Cannot be verified by arithmetic alone: when and where the game charges design cost (R&D row or production) is unobserved. Match the Q2 statements after designing one brand in Q1.

modules.name: 營運產能、加班與排班
modules.real_note: Operating capacity and overtime screens are registered.
modules.ours: None (usable capacity = fixed capacity).
modules.next_step: To heuristic: operating rate below fixed capacity; overtime adds capacity at a premium labour cost.

modules.name: 生產規則與排程

modules.ours: None (production = planned units, capped by capacity).
modules.next_step: To heuristic: changeover loss per brand produced, reduced by changeover investment.

modules.ours: None (quality is fixed at 1 in the demand chain).

modules.name: 庫存持有成本
modules.real_note: An inventory tax parameter is on the captured Q1 statement view and inventory screens are registered; how the game charges holding cost is not observed.
modules.ours: InventoryModule: annual carrying-cost rate (inside the published range) / 4 x value of units left at quarter end (unit cost). Placeholder downstream while unit cost is a placeholder.
modules.next_step: To verified: read the game's holding or inventory-tax charge on a Q2+ statement with known ending inventory; reproduce it.

modules.name: 庫存出清

modules.ours: InventoryModule (heuristic part): units sold off at quarter start bring a labelled salvage fraction of unit cost.
modules.next_step: To verified: observe the game's sell-off price on SellUnwantedInventory once it opens; no general published salvage rate applies, so no literature step.

modules.next_step: To heuristic: a production rule that tops inventory up to a target, needing a production coupling (planned units from a rule) - next round with production.scheduling.

modules.name: 採購、供應商與合約
modules.real_note: Supply-chain strategy, information system, contract and partner-payment screens are registered; the captured Q1 brand screen lists component and scale thresholds, and the capacity screen a supplier field.
modules.ours: PurchasingHeuristic: a quarterly component volume contract earns an all-units discount on the material part of unit cost for the units produced under it; unproduced contract units pay a fee. New production coupling: material cost factor.
modules.next_step: To literature: only if a published range of component volume discounts is found (none so far; Dolan 1987 and Monahan 1984 give the form, not magnitudes). To verified: observe supplier terms (ConfirmRFP) once the screens open.

modules.name: 前置期與供應中斷
modules.real_note: Risk and cost-trend screens are registered; no lead-time field has been seen.
modules.ours: None. The control plane can apply shocks as scenario events (capacity factor), which is a stress test, not a model.
modules.next_step: Deferred on purpose: no evidence yet that the game has lead times or supply disruptions (status unknown). Capture first (Q2+ cost-trend and risk screens); build only what a report shows. The control plane can already stress-test a supply shock as a scenario event.

modules.name: 緊急貸款

modules.name: 所得稅
modules.real_note: A tax-rate and an inventory-tax field appear on the captured Q1 statement view; the captured income statement has a loss carry-forward row before taxable income, and taxes accrual income. The rule was not observed.
modules.ours: Placeholder: max(cash-basis pretax, 0) x tax rate. Known incomplete (no carry-forward, no inventory tax, cash basis). Verified branch: no tax on a pre-tax loss with nothing produced or held (structural zero, as certain as the sign of pretax).
modules.next_step: Cannot be verified by arithmetic alone: needs the game's tax on a profitable quarter. First build the accrual income statement and carry-forward (structure measured), then reproduce the tax row of the first profitable settlement.

modules.name: 現金流量（現金恆等式）
modules.real_note: The captured Q1 cash-flow statement gives the structure: beginning cash, operating receipts and disbursements, investing, financing, ending cash; every row is added with its sign (measured). Its totals are server-computed.
modules.ours: Ending cash = beginning cash + revenue + stock raised + CD flow + interest - operating expenses - capacity investment - tax + emergency loan. Identity reproduced with zero residual in every run (tests), and every engine row maps to a statement row with the same sign. Rows the game has and we do not (rebates, R&D, internet marketing, shipping, excess capacity, licensing, other, loans) are listed; in the captured Q1 projection they are all zero.
modules.next_step: Keep. The identity is verified; each row keeps its own level, so ending cash is only shown as verified when every row is. Re-check against a Q2 cash-flow statement with non-zero rows.

modules.name: 損益表（應計基礎）

modules.ours: Cash-basis profit (production expensed when made, no depreciation, no carry-forward): a different statement. Pre-tax profit and net income never rank above placeholder for that reason.
modules.next_step: To verified (accounting): build the accrual statement from state (COGS on units sold, inventory as an asset, depreciation of capacity, loss carry-forward) and reproduce a Q2 income statement row by row.
